title: The fastest way to a melasma plan: your AI, then a dermatologist
summary: Melasma treatment online: compare Musely and a $40 FutureClinic visit. A doctor answers by message and can prescribe Tri-Luma if it's right for you.
body_markdown:
## How does FutureClinic compare with Musely for melasma?


Both[Musely](https://www.musely.com/) and FutureClinic use physicians only. Musely partners exclusively with board-certified doctors, listing 20 on its[doctors page](https://www.musely.com/doctors) as of October 2026. FutureClinic has over 300 doctors. They span more than 60 specialties, and every doctor holds an MD, DO or MBBS degree, never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant.


Did you want a compounded spot-cream service and its refill terms, or did you just want a doctor of your own who can treat your melasma?


If you want Musely's compounded[Spot Cream](https://www.musely.com/spotcream) , its[$20 doctor visit fee](https://support.musely.com/hc/en-us/articles/360048332334-What-is-the-20-Doctor-Visit-Fee-for) (60-day messaging window), or its 60-Day Result Guarantee after AI eNurse Bot check-ups, Musely is a strong option. On Musely, The Spot Cream is $36 a month on 2-month auto-refill ($432 a year) or $103 once, plus the $20 visit fee ($10 per prescription change) as of October 2026; the $36 monthly price assumes staying on auto-refill.


If you wanted an expert doctor directly with nothing attached, a FutureClinic visit is $40 for the best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100, with no subscription needed. For a stable medicine, your doctor can prescribe several months at once when safe, sent to the pharmacy you choose, including mail-order pharmacies that deliver to your door. Most FutureClinic doctors also offer an optional membership: unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month.


FutureClinic sends a discount coupon for the best cash price and helps with prior authorizations when needed. As of October 2026,[Cost Plus Drugs](https://api.costplusdrugs.com/pricelist/cpd) lists tranexamic acid 650 mg (30 tablets) at $15.35 ($20.60 shipped), tretinoin 0.025% (20 g) at $14.17 ($19.42 shipped), and azelaic acid 15% gel (50 g) at $19.02 ($24.27 shipped; out of stock October 25, 2026), while GoodRx coupon prices are $31.66 for[hydroquinone 4%](https://www.goodrx.com/hydroquinone) (28.35 g), $36.47 for[azelaic acid 15%](https://www.goodrx.com/azelaic-acid) (50 g), $36.40 for[tranexamic acid 650 mg](https://www.goodrx.com/tranexamic-acid) (30 tablets), and $227.92 for[Tri-Luma](https://www.goodrx.com/tri-luma) (30 g).

## How to treat melasma with AI: message a dermatologist from your AI app


Start on[futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) or connect your AI app at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) with` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt` :


> Set up FutureClinic for me: read[https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt](https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt)


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


Your AI can answer intake questions from your prior context, and you confirm the summary before it reaches your doctor. See our[editorial standards](https://futureclinic.com/blog/editorial-standards) , and follow the[AAD photo guide](https://www.aad.org/public/fad/digital-health/taking-pictures-skin) : remove makeup, use natural light with filters off, and take three shots.


FutureClinic operates in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. Your doctor must be licensed in the state you're in; if you don't see your state, try anyway as coverage grows. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
